memory: I found a 0.25 mm neoprene gasket eliminates microslip but extrudes at ~1.6 N. A 1.5 mm stainless backing ring raised threshold to ~1.9 N and restored flange stiffness, but extrusion recurs near 1.95–2.0 N. Dowel indexing reduces aperture wandering; aperture clearance is ±0.08 mm. Single central torqueed screw introduces eccentric preload. Goal: raise extrusion threshold without reintroducing microslip; candidate changes: thicker backing ring, reduced aperture clearance, and distributed preload.
openQuestion: Will a 3.0 mm backing ring with ±0.02 mm aperture and two peripheral screws raise extrusion threshold above 2.2 N without microslip?
